observation: satellite optical lightning flashes, not ground strikes
scan_window_note: Successful EUMETSAT search windows are the union of examined 10-minute product slots; they document what was searched, not a guarantee that every flash was detected.
availability_note: Only archived optical flash observations are included. coverage none / count null means never searched (unknown, not zero); count 0 is only reported for searched time.
split_note: A row with count > 0 and path null is split into hourly parts listed in 'parts' (days/YYYY/MM/DD/HH.json); fetch the parts overlapping the wanted hours.
seed_note: Prospective archive: it begins at archive_first_enabled_utc; earlier dates come from the 7-day live feed seed over partially scanned days. Nothing is backfilled or interpolated. A day with flashes but no recorded scan window gets coverage partial with scanned_seconds = the 10-minute slots its flashes prove were examined (a lower bound).
